newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE WHEAT STEADY, DOMINATED BY SPREADS, TENDING UP.
newsitem.headline: SFE WHEAT STEADY, DOMINATED BY SPREADS, TENDING UP.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures traded steady on Thursday in heavy volume based on spreads.
January 1998 sold steady at A$194.00 a tonne on 65 lots while March 1998 rose by A$1.00 to A$196.50 on 54 lots.
Chris Gray of C, A & L Bell Commodities said the market was dominated by spreads, with January A$2.00 less than March.
The market attracted mainly buying interest.
"It looks like it's going up to me," he said.
Settlement prices on Thursday were mainly steady, although nearby September 1997 fell by A$4.50.
